name: Echoverse
aliases: alternate reality version of the Multiverse
description: The mirror multiverse where Jace died.

description_citations.text: "Vraska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska uses Loot's talents to map a way to the Echoverse from Vryn but does not bring him along.
timeline.quote: she used Loot's talents to map a way there from Vryn, but did not bring him along

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani, Chandra, Vraska and Garruk go to the Echoverse to confront Jace.
timeline.quote: took an Omenpath to the Echoverse

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska stabs Jace to let his aspects overpower the Theorist, and Jace dies after instructing Ajani.
timeline.quote: He reached out to his rescuers, imparting Ajani with instructions on how to fix the disaster he caused, and died peacefully

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul appears and consumes the collapsing Echoverse.
timeline.quote: Emrakul appeared overhead and began to consume it

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, after undoing his compleation, decides to create an alternative to the Multiverse; the Gatewatch regroups to fight him.
timeline.quote: After undoing his compleation on Vryn , he decided to fix the Multiverse by creating an alternative to it , free of suffering.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Against Jace Beleren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Professor Opal traps Liliana and brings her to the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: The white Liliana overcame her original, trapping her and bringing her back to the Echoverse version of Arcavios.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana's lich distracts the Theorist so Vraska can stab him.
timeline.quote: She sent the lich to attack him, which created an opening for Vraska to stab him in the back.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana apologizes to the dying Jace.
timeline.quote: Liliana opened her mind to him, earnestly apologizing for the times she had mistreated him.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana pulls Vraska and Jace's body into the Omenpath to Vryn.
timeline.quote: Liliana grabbed Vraska and Jace's body and pulled them into the Omenpath.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Following the death of the Theorist and Emrakul's assault on the Echoverse, the listed minor characters are presumed dead.
timeline.quote: all characters listed here are presumed deceased.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "List of minor characters". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist in the back and Jace's other aspects overtake his mind.
timeline.quote: This provides an opening for Vraska to stab him in the back

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Battle for the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace accepts his death peacefully, destabilizing the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: he offers those present some final messages before peacefully accepting his death

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Battle for the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul devours the Echoverse before it can collide with the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: devouring the Echoverse before it can collide with the Multiverse

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Battle for the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers' Echoverse counterparts imprison them in mental prisons.
timeline.quote: they were instead confronted by their respective Echoverse counterparts, who overcame them and threw them into mental prisons

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska is separated from the others in a memory trap.
timeline.quote: Vraska became entangled in a memory trap and got separated from the others

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies her Echoverse double and stabs the Theorist, letting Jace's aspects banish him.
timeline.quote: stabbed him in the heart, allowing Jace's aspects to join forces and banish the Theorist

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms.
timeline.quote: His final words were thanks to his Captain, and he passed away

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk, Chandra, Ajani and Vraska enter the Echoverse and fail to reason with Jace; the planeswalkers are thrown into mental prisons.
timeline.quote: The planeswalkers made an initial attempt to reason with Jace, but it failed.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk's empathy frees the Clean Slate, an aspect of Jace as an abused child, which he hosts in his mind.
timeline.quote: He hosted the Clean Slate in his mind as the allies moved forward.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Theorist banishes Garruk into mental space with his accursed counterpart, but Vraska finds and frees them.
timeline.quote: he banished Garruk back into mental space alongside his accursed counterpart

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist in the back and Jace's mind is reunited, but he dies peacefully, thanking Garruk.
timeline.quote: Jace's mind was reunited, but he was dying.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk attacks Liliana as they flee the collapsing Echoverse, but she talks him down, and he leaves after learning she did not curse Rowan.
timeline.quote: Liliana managed to talk him down

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: To stabilize the Echoverse the Theorist creates Hexhaven as his inner sanctum.
timeline.quote: Hexhaven was created as his inner sanctum

citation.text: "Hexhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace creates Tamira as his protege.
timeline.quote: Tamira was designed as Jace's perfect protégé

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Theorist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Theorist has Vraska, Ajani and Chandra tossed into his mental space where the Detective finds them.
timeline.quote: The Theorist had the Echoverse doubles of the four planeswalkers round them up and toss them through a portal to his mental space

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jadzi kills herself, exposing the Theorist to the knowledge of creation.
timeline.quote: Jadzi realized this, and with apparent conviction, grabbed his knife and fatally slashed her own throat.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Theorist binds the two Multiverses together.
timeline.quote: bind the two Multiverses together

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist through the heart and the aspects reunite in Jace.
timeline.quote: Vraska used as an opportunity to ambush him and stab him through the heart

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms.
timeline.quote: Jace died in Vraska's arms, and the last emotion he felt was happiness.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zimone Wola discovers a parallel Multiverse is being created and a spell reveals the image of Chandra.
timeline.quote: the image of Chandra was revealed.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Creation of the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Theorist excises elements from planes' histories to build the Echoverse, but paradoxes pile up and he must lay it atop the existing Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The only way to give it stability was to lay its skin atop the bones of the existing Multiverse.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Reality fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam calls out to Emrakul, telling her there is a Multiverse that needs to be consumed.
timeline.quote: with greatly magnified telepathy called out again to Emrakul, telling her that there was a Multiverse which needed to be consumed.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul partitions the two Multiverses and consumes the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: Back in her body, she looked up and watched Emrakul partition the two Multiverses, drawing the Echoverse into herself and consuming it.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam receives Jace's planeswalker spark and his final message after his death, and planeswalks to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: He had died and passed it on to her, along with a final psychic message asking her to continue his work and always try to make things better.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska stabs the Theorist, Jace's mind is reunited, and he dies peacefully after telling Chandra she was like family.
timeline.quote: He reached out to his rescuers, telling Chandra she had been like family to him and apologizing for his coldness toward her, and died peacefully.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul appears and consumes the collapsing Echoverse, saving the Multiverse; Chandra escapes to Vryn.
timeline.quote: Emrakul appeared overhead and began to consume it, preventing it from colliding with the original Multiverse.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to fix the Multiverse by creating an alternative to it, free of suffering, and excises people and events he disliked.
timeline.quote: He excised people and events from the Echoverse's history as if they never existed.

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace uses the magical energy of Hexhaven Academy to stabilize his creation.
timeline.quote: Jace uses this place of abundant magical energy to stabilize his creation.

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Echoverse is revealed to be hungry, needing to consume everything it imitates and to be laid over the Multiverse to stabilize.
timeline.quote: To sustain itself, it needs to consume everything it imitates.

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch assembles to fight one of its founding members, Jace, to prevent the Multiverse from being overwritten.
timeline.quote: the Gatewatch assembles to fight one of its founding members

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Jace, preventing the Echoverse from overlaying the Multiverse, though both realities remain intertwined.
timeline.quote: After Jace is killed by Vraska, the overlay of the Echoverse onto the Multiverse is prevented

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam, receiving Jace's spark, summons Emrakul from Innistrad's moon; Emrakul consumes the Echoverse and severs it from the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi travels to the Echoverse and consumes it, simultaneously severing it from the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam contacts Emrakul on Innistrad; Emrakul learns of the Echoverse and demands to be guided to it, frightening Tam.
timeline.quote: Emrakul demanded that Tam guide her to the Echoverse so she could destroy it

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Consuming the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam, empowered by Jace's spark, calls Emrakul, who separates the Echoverse from the Multiverse and consumes it.
timeline.quote: dematerialized the latter, pulling it into herself and consuming it.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Consuming the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam contacts Emrakul in the moon and Emrakul learns of the Echoverse; Tam severs the link when Emrakul demands to destroy it.
timeline.quote: Emrakul demanded that Tam guide her to the Echoverse so she could destroy it, which frightened Tam into severing their psychic connection.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisoned in the moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul separates the Multiverse from the Echoverse and consumes the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: dematerialized the latter, pulling it into herself and consuming it.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Consuming the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace creates the Echoverse, intended to be free of suffering.
timeline.quote: Jace has created the Echoverse , intended to be free of suffering.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
